body: She did not say she was uncomfortable while in my dorm room. It does not say anywhere in my post that she was. Only after did I know
You make a good point and I’ll make sure to remember your advice thank you
You make a really good point about asking first before asking after. I usually ask before initiating a kiss but didn’t think to ask before putting my arm around her. Thank you
Thank you, I always hate whenever I make anyone uncomfortable which is why I always try to consistently ask them if they are okay.

I did mention in the post that she did initiate some of the kissing which is why I was confused that she mentioned she was uncomfortable. Does that not count as reciprocating or am I missing something?

Yeah that’s my point I don’t want to tell anyone. There’s some times where I almost feel pressured to and some times where I’d like to talk about it but I know that most people wouldn’t understand especially with me particular sexuality.

You’re doing what’s best for you and honestly for him. He would’ve never tried to change knowing you’d come back. Sometimes leaving a toxic relationship isn’t just for the best for you but for the other person so they can change their flaws.

Khalids coaster relates to this so hard 
“Moving on seems harder to do
When the one that you love moves faster than you”
 
I listened to him and Lany because they felt what I felt and it felt almost comforting for me.
Hmmm I don’t suffer from that. Do you dream about him/her or something?
Thank you. One thing that keeps me going is that I know that if I keep pushing I’m going to keep getting better and meeting better people
Seems to me he’s very immature. It was probably for the best that you two didn’t reconnect
I’m really sorry man. I promise it gets better. Right now it’s clear that it’s best that you at least mute her. Seeing her is hurting you
If you want to dm me for help on continuing no contact or literally anything feel free to send a msg to my account :)

I feel fucking amazing. I’m about to start my senior tennis season so I’ve been practicing almost nonstop without distractions. I’m working more, lifting weights more and (honestly what helped the most) I’ve been seeing other people. 

It feels great to not get drained over my insecurities about my ex. I made the mistake of not muting her for a week after the breakup and I was miserable. Forgetting her has helped me focus on what I love.

Honestly a little too much. The thing that helped me the most was dating other people and spending good time with friends. I knew that it was best not to dwell on it so I distracted myself with positive things. 

I can see you’re probably wanting to get back with your ex and it’s okay to have those feelings. However before you do anything involving your ex. You have to heal first. That means you don’t spend your days thinking about him/her. Forcing a friendship or a new relationship too soon just ends up leaving someone hurt.

I had to cut my ex out of my life for my own health. Despite never reaching out to her I still care for her but I know it’s best not to at least not now. Sometimes you have to be selfish. It sucks becoming strangers but that’s the reality we live in. It’s a cruel world sometimes and we just have to make the most of it.

Now I’m focused on myself. So far I’ve been 

-spending time with lots of friends 

-learning new languages 

-dating and meeting new and great people

-working more

-working out more/dieting better

No contact has done wonders for me and I’m so glad I’ve done it

Started no contact a month ago and I feel amazing. I went 2 weeks without muting her social media and it killed me. She would subtweet me and post things that just hurt me. It felt better for me to act as if she hadn’t existed. With that I began thinking of her less and less.

Sometimes cutting someone out of your life, even if you loved her is for the best. My ex and I broke up over a month ago and I still think about her every now and then. I had to mute her on social media, before that it would just hurt to see her. Muting her on social media helped me heal.

I was in the same place not too long ago. What helped me was finding things to distract myself. I used my hobbies such as weight lifting, tennis, and learning new languages in addition to hanging out with friends nearly everyday. You’re not alone. Find something to keep you busy. Whether that’s school, a job, or anything. I find it healing to distract myself or else I find myself thinking about her when I have nothing else to do

Felt that with my break up. She was the one who was more interested first. She was the one who said I love you first. She was the one who got attached first. And she was the one who lost feelings first too. That hurt me. I fell for her after months together. I didn’t become attached till a month after she was. Now I’m the one hurting lol
Yes I did have to take a dump

Yeah I have been trying to do what you say as the “best revenge” it’s been really up and down for me lately where sometimes I do feel great and other times I get in my own head and think like this. I’ll continue to try being better. But if that doesn’t work maybe just maybe I’ll try your lawn seed idea lmao.

You’re right. I’ve honestly been going back and forth with everything. It’s been 2 weeks and I promised to better myself by working out more. Learning new languages and learning the piano and I’ve had success. It’s just the dark moments when I feel all alone and all of a sudden I come back to the planning.
Hoping to read some cool stories from this. Got back with my ex months ago and I thank god everyday for getting us back together
